theory.intro: Absolute value changes either the output or the input. Check where the bars sit.
facts: $|f(x)|$: keep the part above the $x$-axis; reflect the part below it upward.
$f(|x|)$: keep the right-hand half; reflect it in the $y$-axis.
$|f(x)|$ keeps the original domain. $f(|x|)$ is defined where $|x|$ belongs to the original domain.
steps: Identify which quantity is inside the bars
